contact.heading: Text Rena's Rentals for Tour Times and Current Group Options
contact.body: Tell us your group size, preferred home, and timing. Full roommate groups and smaller 2-4 person groups can inquire about current options.

homes.heading: Tour the Homes: 5005, 5011, and 5013 63rd St
homes.body: The homes are near SDSU in the College Area, with private bedrooms, full-home lease options, shared living space, and parking details to confirm.
homes.note: These homes are intended for full-home or group lease arrangements near SDSU. Have 2-4 people? You can still inquire about current group options and tour availability.

groupOptions.heading: Have 2-4 People? Start the Conversation Now.
groupOptions.body: You do not need to have a full group before reaching out. Tell us your current group size, timing, and preferred home.

finalCta.heading: Request Tour Times Today.
finalCta.body: Text your group size, preferred home, and tour timing. Rena's Rentals can send current group options, photos, available video, and next steps.

faqs.question: How close are the homes to SDSU?
faqs.answer: The Rena's Rentals pages describe the 63rd Street homes as a 10 minute walk to campus near 63rd & Pontiac.

faqs.question: Can a smaller group inquire?
faqs.answer: Yes. You do not need to have a full group before reaching out.

faqs.question: Can parents join the tour?
faqs.answer: Yes. Parents and guarantors can join in-person or video tours and ask questions.
